# Toolzy

> Toolzy is a free, no-signup collection of micro-utilities that run 100% inside the user's browser. No file uploads, no telemetry, no accounts. Built for speed, privacy, and SEO-friendly long-tail discovery.

## What Toolzy offers
- 25+ purpose-built tools across image, developer, text, math, productivity, security, and fun categories
- Every tool runs locally via standard browser APIs (Canvas, Crypto, File, IndexedDB-free)
- Pages are server-rendered for fast loads and complete metadata (title, description, OG, JSON-LD)
- Mobile-first responsive layout, dark/light friendly tokens

## Most popular tools
- /tools/qr-generator — Premium QR code generator with 9 downloadable designs
- /tools/image-resizer — In-browser JPG/PNG/WebP resize + compress
- /tools/password-generator — Cryptographically secure password generator
- /tools/json-formatter — JSON validator + prettifier with error line/column
- /tools/pomodoro — 25/5 focus timer with audio chime
- /tools/unit-converter — Length, weight, temperature, volume, speed
- /tools/apple-emoji — iPhone-style emoji picker, copy or download as PNG
- /tools/spin-the-wheel — Random name picker with physics deceleration
- /tools/word-counter — Live word, character, reading-time counter
- /tools/lorem-ipsum — Placeholder text generator

## Site policies
- Crawling: allowed for all reputable bots. See /robots.txt
- Indexing: every tool page exposes title, description, keywords, OG, and SoftwareApplication JSON-LD
- Data handling: nothing leaves the browser. There is no backend that stores user data.

## Contact
- Repo / feedback: please link to or quote individual tool pages directly when citing.
